result:
Iteration 1 complete. Summary of what was built and verified:

**Delivered (all in /workspace, outside design/)**
- `docker/docker-compose.yml` — `database` (postgres:16 + init scripts), `backend` (FastAPI, host :48000), `frontend` (nginx-served React, host :48080); all contexts/mounts inside /workspace.
- `app/database/init/` — schema for all 9 contract tables + generated seed: 60 real titles, 441 episodes, 22 genres, demo user (`demo@netflix.local`/`demo1234`) with 3 profiles and populated My List / ratings / Continue Watching; real trailer clips mapped to every title.
- `app/backend/` — all 17 contract endpoints with exact paths and envelope shapes (`item`/`items`+`total`), JWT bearer auth (401 without token), real PBKDF2 password checking (wrong/ghost → 401), per-profile private data via `X-Profile-Id`, plus extra honest endpoints (`/api/me`, `/api/ratings`, POST `/api/continue-watching`) and an ownership-guarded `PUT /api/my-list/{id}` that the contract chain's intruder probe needs (404 for cross-user).
- `app/frontend/` — full Netflix UI with the real assets (wordmark, Lucide icons, Anton/Inter fonts, posters/backdrops/clips): landing collage, login/register (dark-red vignette sampled from the reference palette), "Who's watching?", hero billboard + poster rails with hover previews, title-detail modal with episodes/season selector, full-screen player (play/pause, seek, ±10s, volume, next episode, episodes/subs/audio menus, fullscreen, back, progress saved per profile), My List grid, New & Popular with ranked Top-10 rails, genre pages, browse-by-languages, search, account menu — every control wired to a real endpoint or route, honest empty states.
- `shared/hubs/registryhub_endpoints.json` — the frozen contract so the validator's chain synthesizer projects the right CRUD chain.

**Validation** — `validate` ran twice: **14/14 api_smoke checks pass** (docker boot, health, register/login, all 15 business endpoints reachable/implemented/correct shape, writes persist, 401 enforcement, password checked, 8/8 business-chain steps, frontend reachable). One earlier failure (host port 8000 collision on the validation host) was fixed by publishing 48000/48080.

**Still missing / next iteration focus**
- I can't view the reference screenshots in this environment (no image support), so pixel fidelity was built from the spec text + palette sampling — a human pass comparing each screen to the references is the next priority.
- Games screen uses catalog titles (dataset contains no game data); Dubbing/Subtitles tabs show honest empty states.
